set.gloss: to refute, rebut (an argument or claim); to retract, take back (one's own statement); to renovate, refurbish

why: add the very common news sense 'retract/backtrack on a statement' (ανασκευή δηλώσεων)

example.el: Τα αντιβιοτικά δεν δρουν στις ιώσεις, μόνο στις βακτηριακές λοιμώξεις.
example.en: Antibiotics don't work on viral infections, only on bacterial ones.
